name: screens_viewer
title: Screens Viewer
description: Website screens section: a stage with the selected screen paired with its counterpart in the laptop + phone mockup (card_post_project_visual_devices_website, desktop-and-phone), a counter + title, a rail of device-mockup thumbnails (the old web gallery tiles) with arrows, and the full captures in the popup gallery. Screens: web/website/desktop|phone, plus web/content-website/<folder>/desktop|phone groups. Only the selected pair is in the page, the others wait in <template>s.
